math5-place-value-number-sense.title: Sports Stats Showdown
math5-place-value-number-sense.tagline: Be the official statistician for Field Day: read, compare, order and round decimal results.
math5-place-value-number-sense.description: Students become the Field Day statisticians. They read and write decimal race times and jump distances, compare and order them to award medals, round results for the scoreboard, and use powers of 10 to scale ticket and snack sales.

math5-multi-digit-multiplication-divisio.title: School Carnival Planner
math5-multi-digit-multiplication-divisio.tagline: Plan the school carnival: tickets, prizes, tables and buses, all with multi-digit math.
math5-multi-digit-multiplication-divisio.description: Students plan a school carnival. They multiply to find ticket and prize totals, divide to share supplies and arrange buses and tables, interpret remainders, and estimate to check that the plan makes sense.

math5-decimal-operations.title: Class Party Budget
math5-decimal-operations.tagline: Plan an end-of-year class party without going over budget.
math5-decimal-operations.description: Students plan an end-of-year class party. They add the costs of decorations and food, multiply decimal prices by quantities, divide to find the cost per student and the better buy, and subtract to stay within the budget.

math5-numerical-expressions-patterns.title: Theme Park Points
math5-numerical-expressions-patterns.tagline: Use expressions and patterns to plan the best day at a theme park.
math5-numerical-expressions-patterns.description: Students plan a theme park day. They write and evaluate expressions with grouping symbols for ride points and costs, interpret expressions without calculating, generate two numerical patterns for two savings plans, and graph the ordered pairs to compare them.

math5-fraction-addition-subtraction.title: School Garden Plan
math5-fraction-addition-subtraction.tagline: Design a school garden where every fraction adds up.
math5-fraction-addition-subtraction.description: Students design a school garden. They split a garden into fractional sections with unlike denominators, check that the sections make one whole, add and subtract mixed numbers for fence and path lengths, and use benchmark fractions to check that answers are reasonable.

math5-fraction-multiplication-division.title: Recipe Remix
math5-fraction-multiplication-division.tagline: Scale a recipe up and down and share it fairly using fraction multiplication and division.
math5-fraction-multiplication-division.description: Students run a cooking club. They scale a recipe by whole numbers, fractions and mixed numbers, explain scaling, interpret fractions as division when sharing, and divide whole numbers by unit fractions to find servings.

math5-measurement-conversions.title: Field Trip Packing List
math5-measurement-conversions.tagline: Pack for an outdoor field trip by converting units of length, weight and capacity.
math5-measurement-conversions.description: Students pack for a nature field trip. They convert gallons of water to cups, feet of rope to inches, pounds to ounces for backpack weight, and metric distances, solving multi-step problems with regrouping.

math5-volume-three-dimensional-figures.title: Miniature City Builder
math5-volume-three-dimensional-figures.tagline: Design a miniature city of buildings and find the volume of every one.
math5-volume-three-dimensional-figures.description: Students design a miniature city. They build rectangular-prism buildings from unit cubes, find volumes with V = l × w × h and V = B × h, find volumes of L-shaped (composite) buildings, and plan how many boxes fit in a delivery truck.

math5-coordinate-plane-graphing.title: Playground Designer
math5-coordinate-plane-graphing.tagline: Place playground equipment on a coordinate grid and measure paths and fences.
math5-coordinate-plane-graphing.description: Students design a playground on a coordinate grid. They plot equipment at ordered pairs, find distances along grid lines, find the fourth corner and perimeter of rectangular areas, and interpret a graph of visitors over time.

math5-classifying-two-dimensional-figure.title: Shape Mosaic Designer
math5-classifying-two-dimensional-figure.tagline: Create a mosaic and prove what every shape in it is.
math5-classifying-two-dimensional-figure.description: Students design a mosaic for the school entrance. They classify triangles by sides and angles, classify quadrilaterals by their properties, use the shape hierarchy to explain how shapes are related, and describe regular polygons.

math5-data-line-plots-problem-solving.title: Plant Growth Investigation
math5-data-line-plots-problem-solving.tagline: Measure seedlings, make a line plot, and answer questions about the data.
math5-data-line-plots-problem-solving.description: Students run a plant-growth investigation. They organize fraction measurements of seedlings in a line plot, find totals and differences, find an equal (fair) share of water, and solve a multi-step problem with the data.
